# Fixed PI: Kp=2, Ki=1, plant y'=-y+u. Exact ZOH plant, controller dt=.01.
# Compare only this implementation, not optimized controller rankings.
def run_aw(level, aw=False, separation=False, dt=.01):
    y=0.; z=0.; rows=[]
    for k in range(round(20/dt)+1):
        t=k*dt; r=level if t<10 else .5
        e=r-y; raw=2*e+z; u=np.clip(raw,-1,1)
        rows.append((t,r,y,u,z))
        dz=e if not separation or abs(e)<=.5 else 0.
        if aw: dz+=u-raw
        z+=dt*dz
        y=np.exp(-dt)*y+(1-np.exp(-dt))*u
    return np.array(rows)
for level in [.5,1.,3.]:
    for aw,sep in [(False,False),(True,False),(False,True),(True,True)]:
        a=run_aw(level,aw,sep)
        print("level,AW,separation, y(10),I(10),y(20)",level,aw,sep,*a[1000,[2,4]],a[-1,2])
        assert np.max(abs(a[:,3]))<=1
        if level==3: assert a[999,2]<1.001 # impossible to track r=3 with u<=1
    a=run_aw(level);b=run_aw(level,True)
    if level==.5: assert np.allclose(a,b)
    plt.plot(a[:,0],a[:,2],label='plain');plt.plot(b[:,0],b[:,2],label='back calculation');plt.title('reference '+str(level));plt.legend();plt.show()
# Half-step convergence, same times, no comparison tuning claim.
a=run_aw(3,True);b=run_aw(3,True,dt=.005)
print("half-step max y error",np.max(abs(a[:,2]-b[::2,2])))

# Retain old G=10/(s+1), Ts=.05; exact ZOH. Raw PID can oscillate with saturation.
Ts=.05; t=np.arange(101)*Ts
for gains in [(3.,1.,.2),(.1,.1,0.)]:
    kp,ki,kd=gains; y=0.;u=0.; ep=0.;epp=0.; rows=[]
    for time in t:
        e=1-y;du=kp*(e-ep)+ki*Ts*e+kd/Ts*(e-2*ep+epp)
        u=float(np.clip(u+du,-10,10));rows.append((y,u))
        y=np.exp(-Ts)*y+10*(1-np.exp(-Ts))*u
        epp,ep=ep,e
    rows=np.array(rows)
    print("gains, last y, sampled peak, max |u|",gains,rows[-1,0],np.max(rows[:,0]),np.max(abs(rows[:,1])))
    assert np.max(abs(rows[:,1]))<=10
    plt.plot(t,rows[:,0],label=str(gains))
plt.legend();plt.xlabel('t (s)');plt.show()
# Position/increment equality only before saturation, identical initial states.
e=np.array([1.,.7,.2,-.1]);pos=2*e+.1*np.cumsum(e)+5*np.diff(np.r_[0,e]);inc=[];u=0.;ep=0.;epp=0.
for v in e:
    u+=7.1*v-12*ep+5*epp;inc.append(u);epp,ep=ep,v
assert np.allclose(pos,inc);print("Q9 positions/increments",pos,inc)

R,L,J,B,km,kb=1.,.5,.01,.1,.02,.02
physical=np.polymul([L,R],[J,B]);physical[-1]+=km*kb
print("physical denominator",physical,"normalized",physical/physical[0],"numerator",km/physical[0])
assert np.allclose(physical,[.005,.06,.1004])
print("open poles",np.roots(physical))
print("P Kp=5 ess",1/(1+5*km/physical[-1]),"P gain for ess<1%",99*physical[-1]/km)
# Same historical candidates, no independent tuning or ranking. Unit speed step, no load/noise/limits.
for name,cn,cd in [('P',[5],[1]),('PI',[5,50],[1,0]),('ideal PID',[.5,5,50],[1,0]),('filtered PID',[.55,5.5,50],[.01,1,0])]:
    sys=closed([km],physical,cn,cd)
    poles=np.roots(sys.den); assert np.max(poles.real)<0
    t,y=curve(sys,10,10001); limit=sys.num[-1]/sys.den[-1]
    crossings=[t[np.flatnonzero(y>=v)[0]] if np.any(y>=v) else np.nan for v in [.1*limit,.9*limit]]
    print(name,"den",sys.den,"poles",poles,"limit",limit,"sample tr 10-90",crossings[1]-crossings[0],"sample overshoot wrt limit",max(0,np.max(y)/limit-1)*100,"y(10)",y[-1])
    plt.plot(t,y,label=name)
plt.legend();plt.xlabel('t (s)');plt.show()
